name: load_skill
description: Read a skill's full contents (prompt body, system prompt, bundled resource directory if any) by name, without changing the current turn. Use to inspect, learn from, or modify an existing skill (e.g. authoring or debugging). Returns text only; it does NOT activate the skill or alter your tool set. The returned text omits the manifest's `tools`, `tool_groups`, `mcp_servers` and `priority` — re-saving from it drops them, so a skill that restricted its tools is saved with the default turn groups instead.

name.description: Exact name of the skill to read.
